same as statement 13: (Although sk_know_1 sk_know_3) takes a first argument that lives only inside the seal and is not the main clause.

"knew OF the girl" is a prepositional verb, whose object the instruction set routes to the preposition-named oblique (Of sk_know_1 sk_girl_1) rather than to a direct-object role such as Stimulus.
